source_version_boundaries: 2604.00715v1 April and v2 August have different titles and metric emphasis. v1 uses per-token gold-answer PPL; v2 uses character-normalized gold-answer NLL, Brier score and decision error. Neither establishes universal retrieval benefit.
A four-pretraining-tokens-per-parameter crossover shown in the lecture is excluded from generalized textbook claims.
Bilingual sentence-switching English PPL differs (5.26 versus 2.69), even when grammar and word-similarity metrics are closer. Budget units are words, not tokenizer units.
GRPO reward source and group baseline are separate; the chapter does not call it self-ranking.
BrainInterNet attention and reconstructability are model/data predictive objects; clinical diagnosis and physiological causality are not established by them.
Paper reading entries identify checked claims and pages, not entire-paper comprehension or inspection of unseen plots.
